changeReason: This final headroom test isolates the additional value of bounded transitive version-chain traversal over invalidation-only filtering. The same stale-exposed population, hash-stratified sample rule, models, thresholds, and uncertainty method are retained; only the comparator arm changes from oracle_query to oracle_chain.
population: forgetting-bearing Memora questions where the frozen MemoryCore Base top-5 contains at least one value-matched assertion predating its gold correction/deletion event

evaluation.judgeMode: single fixed judge; all criteria for one answer batched in one JSON response
